page_title: EVE 1-0 SHU | Everton v Sheffield Utd 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+6' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Chermiti (Everton) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90+3' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Andre Gomes walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lewis Warrington (Everton).
90+2' Chris Wilder is stunned as referee Stuart Attwell shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
81' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) replacing Cameron Archer.
81' The attendance for today's match is 39221.

81' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
79' Chermiti (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
78' James Garner (Everton) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sheffield Utd.
74' Sheffield Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

74' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sheffield Utd.
71' The referee signals a corner kick to Sheffield Utd.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andre Gomes (Everton) is coming onto the pitch as Dwight McNeil cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Abdoulaye Doucoure and he is replaced by Lewis Dobbin (Everton).

66' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
63' The substitution is prepared. Sam Curtis (Sheffield Utd) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ollie Arblaster.
61' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
60' Sheffield Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
55' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. Andre Brooks is replaced by Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd).
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yasser Larouci departs the field of play to be replaced by Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd).
54' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) for a tough tackle.
53' Excellent touch by James Garner (Everton)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
52' Amadou Onana (Everton) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
52' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner with a short pass.

51' Amadou Onana (Everton) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Everton force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' Abdoulaye Doucoure receives a sweet pass inside the box from James Garner (Everton), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
48' Stuart Attwell blows for a foul after Seamus Coleman (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+3' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Everton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
43' James Garner (Everton) has a great chance to score, but he blasts the ball well wide of the left post.
41' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the right post is smartly dealt with by Jordan Pickford.
38' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
36' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) receives a yellow card.
36' The yellow card is received by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton).
33' James Garner (Everton) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
31' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 1:0.
30' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post.
29' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Wesley Foderingham is equal to it and makes an easy save.
25' Seamus Coleman (Everton) makes a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
19' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stuart Attwell no option but to blow his whistle.
14' None of the Everton players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

14' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gets in a promising position inside the box after a rebound, but his resulting header towards the top of the net is too weak and the goalkeeper saves it easily. The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
14' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
12' Amadou Onana (Everton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

11' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Wesley Foderingham makes a comfortable save.
10' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
7' Amadou Onana (Everton) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
6' Ashley Young (Everton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

4' Wesley Foderingham pulls off a great save to deny Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
2' The corner from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is cleared away by the defence.
2' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Sheffield Utd have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Sheffield Utd will take the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
